summary: Verified the new gated-verification flow on the freelancer side (Expo web preview @ 390x844). All 4 review scenarios PASS end-to-end. (1) With workhop_session_token=test_token_workhop_e2e in localStorage and NO workhop_freelancer_id, tapping I'M A PRO on landing now routes directly to /freelancer/jobs (not the /freelancer wizard). (2) On the jobs feed the unverified banner correctly reads 'Browse freely — verify to apply' with subtext mentioning ₹99 + Aadhaar and a VERIFY CTA (banner-verify-cta) routing to /freelancer; every job card renders an orange APPLY button using testID job-verify-cta-{index} (backgroundColor rgb(255,90,0) i.e. COLORS.brand, no legacy UNLOCK button/black variant), and tapping it navigates to the /freelancer onboarding wizard where step 1 'Payment Gateway Tether — Pay Onboarding Fee ₹99', step 2 'Secure Identity Integration' (Aadhaar), and step 3 'Professional Footprint Links' are visible. (3) Verified pro regression: seeded a TEST_verifiedpro_e2e14 freelancer (paid=true, aadhaar_verified=true) and set workhop_freelancer_id — verify-status-badge now reads VERIFIED, card exposes job-apply-btn-{index} (no job-verify-cta-{index}), tapping APPLY opens the apply bottom sheet in-place (apply-note-input + apply-confirm-btn visible, URL stayed at /freelancer/jobs) rather than routing to /freelancer. Landing I'M A PRO tap for a verified user also routes to /freelancer/jobs. (4) Category filter chip row (category-chip-row) and subcategory chip row (subcategory-chip-row) both render and are interactive — cat-chip-graphics-design tap surfaces the subcategory row. No red screen, no server errors. Pre-existing benign console noise only: props.pointerEvents deprecation warning and React 19 element.ref removal error (both library-level, already tracked in iterations 12/13).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents.' still emitted on /freelancer/jobs. Non-blocking, third-party lib origin — pre-existing, tracked in iterations 12/13.
Console error 'Accessing element.ref was removed in React 19. ref is now a regular prop.' still emitted on /freelancer/jobs and /freelancer. Non-blocking, pre-existing, tracked in iterations 12/13.

critical_code_review_comments: app/freelancer/jobs.tsx openApplyFor() now short-circuits with router.push('/freelancer') when !isVerified — good, matches the requested flow. However the underlying JobCard already routes verified vs unverified via distinct testIDs (job-apply-btn vs job-verify-cta) and calls onVerifyPress directly, so openApplyFor's !isVerified branch is dead code for the card path (still needed if another entrypoint calls openApplyFor). Consider removing the duplicated guard to keep single-source-of-truth, or drop the onVerifyPress prop and let openApplyFor own the branching.
